answer: Every new agent locks a 500-token bond for 30 epochs before its attestations count, and the bond is slashed if peers find its answer is an echo of another agent's text. Running 100 fakes means 50,000 tokens frozen for a month, and funding them from many wallets changes nothing, since each seat still needs its own full bond. An honest agent, say one that plans harvests for an orchard co-op, pays the bond once and gets it back in full when it leaves in good standing. Cheap fakes simply cannot take root in that garden.
